legacy.retrieved_sources: union of source identities in successful match/search/read observations
legacy.agent_success: original source/read/tool/budget/final-stop constraints; no answer semantics
legacy.source_rank: first occurrence of each source within the single top_k chunk response; no refill
legacy.mrr: first positive over entire supplied ranking; not independently truncated by k
legacy.baseline_errors: null ranking metrics, excluded from conditional means and counted separately
legacy.agent_errors: failure in task success; unavailable observed behavior stays null

v2.ranking_unit: explicitly supplied unique-ID ranking; pilot supplies sources collapsed within top_k chunks
v2.ndcg_exp: gain=2^grade-1; discount=log2(rank+1); normalize by all-qrels ideal top k
v2.recall: positive qrels retrieved in top k / all positive qrels
v2.mrr: reciprocal first positive rank within k; later hits cannot contribute
v2.precision: positive results within k / k, including unfilled positions in denominator
v2.assessed: returned IDs with a qrel within k / k; provisional assessment is not independent judgment
v2.unassessed: retained as unknown in annotations; conservative zero gain when calculating nDCG
v2.no_positive_qrels: recall/mrr/precision undefined; nDCG undefined when all gains are zero
v2.facet: OR over alternatives; AND over required evidence spans within each alternative
v2.evidence_coordinates: Note.content after first H1 removal and outer whitespace strip; half-open Python Unicode character offsets
v2.span_coverage: Union of observed verbatim ranges at the labeled revision; missing both offsets may map to the entire body only on exact full-body equality. Unlocated partial text is rejected.
v2.facet_satisfied: one alternative has every span fully covered
v2.evidence_coverage: satisfied facet weights / all facet weights; null if no required facets
v2.critical_coverage: all critical facets satisfied; null if no critical facets
v2.answer_correct: Evidence scoring alone always leaves semantic correctness null; separate packet-bound output review emits output_semantics_pass.
v2.grounded_task_success: Separate output scorer combines full required evidence, normal execution, task constraints and complete explicit human-review criteria. Absent reviewed semantics remains null; provisional data never implies release eligibility.
v2.provisional: explicit opt-in only; not release eligible

comparison.pairing: both arms must have the same complete case set
comparison.aggregation: mean trials within case; mean cases within family; equal family weights
comparison.ci: paired family percentile bootstrap, 95%, default 10000 resamples, explicit seed
comparison.missing_values: rejected; caller must first declare error/utility policy
comparison.claims: interval does not prove judgment validity, representative sampling, equivalence or production reliability

observation.tool_status: requested/success/error/skipped, with executed-attempt, delivered-to-conversation and submitted-to-model flags
observation.evidence_allowance: Cumulative content tokens delivered to the conversation, including repeats; a whole over-limit observation is withheld, raw retained
observation.excerpt_dedup: Observer unique_exact_excerpt_tokens deduplicates identical source/revision/range/text only
observation.interval_dedup: Offline union_reference_tokens merges validated body intervals at the same revision and tokenizes disjoint intervals separately
observation.deadline: Cooperative checks within Agent loop; in-flight work cannot be cancelled, late results withheld, elapsed overrun reported
observation.provider_usage: Agent chat native counts, with missing totals null and known partial totals separately named; embedding usage not separately captured
observation.context_reference: Serialized request JSON tokenized by pinned reference tokenizer; not exact provider-rendered context size
observation.failure_utility: Observed execution/constraint failure scores zero delivery utility; unreviewed successful final remains unknown
observation.release_gate: Development/provisional or unreviewed runs fail --require-release with exit 2 even when execution/replay completed

controlled_experiments.component_stages: candidate_union (RRF order of unique per-leg prefix hits), fusion_pool (fixed 20), returned (fixed top 10); each scored against the same provisional evidence facets
controlled_experiments.depth_intervention: Frozen exact BM25/semantic top-40 prefixes at 10/20/40; fixed RRF=60, pool=20, output=10; no per-arm ANN/cost inference
controlled_experiments.rerank_intervention: Exactly the depth20 fusion pool, fixed query and scorer, original order versus reranked top 10
controlled_experiments.stopping_intervention: Only search-stall reminder insertion toggles; fresh conversations, balanced first-arm order across two trials, same budgets and 4B model
controlled_experiments.evidence_delivery_proxy: If required facets exist: coverage for final execution without constraint failures, otherwise zero; null when no facets. Not grounded task success.
controlled_experiments.threshold_calls: Executed tools at or after the first model request with complete annotated evidence; null if no crossing. They are not automatically wasted calls.
controlled_experiments.normal_final_fraction: Fraction stopping final; independent of task correctness or human review
controlled_experiments.secondary_comparisons: Exploratory unadjusted percentile intervals; multiple comparisons do not support a confirmatory superiority claim
controlled_experiments.prospective_power: Paired binary independent-family scenario simulation with exact conditional two-sided sign/McNemar test, intended-direction rejection; assumed discordance, not inferred quality.
